During the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], a '''squad''' of [[Imperial soldier]]s was assigned to the first wave of shuttles landing on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Hesker codex" />

Comprised of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], including the young [[Hesker]] who had yet to participate in any battles, the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] group was intended only as dispensable men tasked in diverting initial fire from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, the squad member Hesker refused to become mere cannon fodder, and so the [[Human/Legends|Human]] took charge of the squad, leading the Imperial soldiers to break the defense lines of the Republic, thereby enabling the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to turn the battle into a rout.<ref name="Hesker codex" />
